notes.title: A letter from Shawnee Smith!
notes.content:
⏳ Tormentor Crowdfunding – 3 Days LeftWe’ve officially hit our goal: €30,165 raised by 437 backers – 100% funded on IndieGoGo.
Thank you to everyone who believed in Tormentor and helped us bring it to life without compromise. Every share, comment, and contribution got us here. We still have 3 days left in the campaign, and we’ll continue posting updates and previews for all of you until the very end.


A letter from Shawnee!
And for fans of Bloody Mary, we have something special in store. Shawnee Smith, the legendary actress behind her, sat down to share a few thoughts on stepping into this chilling role:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/96968006f694ef2f113326999c651c08c16cea55.png"]
[hr][/hr]
Q: How did you feel when approached with the opportunity to become Bloody Mary?
Apprehensive because it was so violent and curious to explore that anger and vengeance within me.

Q: Favorite voice line to record?
“Open your mouth and say, AAAAAHHHH!!!”

Q: How does your approach to acting change when performing for a video game?
Working more so with imagination as opposed to working “off of” the other actor.

Q: How much of Shawnee is in Bloody Mary?
I’d never admit it publicly.

Q: What are you most excited for with her release?
“Most excited for …?” Excited? I’m terrified! This is terrifying!

Q: If given the opportunity, what would be the one element you would add to Bloody Mary?
A better body. I’M KIDDING!! I actually care about her, so, I’d say, forgiveness, before it’s “game over.”
[hr][/hr]
If given the opportunity, what would you ask this legendary actress? 
Bonus points if you keep it Tormentor related!

🩸 New Challenger Edition – €6,666

This tier includes design input on a 4th playable DLC character. If you want to shape the next sadist in the world of Tormentor, this is your chance. It also includes nearly all major rewards like your name engraved in-game, exclusive contracts, full Madmind access, and more.



Just 4 days remain to join the campaign and help us bring this twisted vision to life.

notes.title: Important Announcement regarding the Crowdfunding.
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We want to share an update about the Tormentor crowdfunding campaign.

After careful consideration and conversations with Kickstarter, it became clear that we couldn’t launch the campaign on their platform without compromising the core of what makes Tormentor what it is. The required changes would have altered too much of the game’s identity, and watering down its vision, as such, we did not want to compromise.

Because of this, we’ve decided to move the campaign to IndieGoGo. It’s a platform that allows us to present Tormentor exactly as we envisioned it. The move means we’re starting over, and our follower count has been reset, but the game remains unchanged. 

Please support our campaign at the following link: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/tormentor-enter-the-nightmare-become-the-monster/coming_soon

notes.title: Ezekiel – Brutal. Silent. Relentless.
notes.content:
In the twisted world of Agony, there are no heroes, only monsters. Among them, Ezekiel stands apart. Known only as The Tormentor, he is the original executioner, the embodiment of raw power, and the silent force behind the game’s darkest acts of violence. There is no joy in his work. No flair. No theatrics. Just pain, control, and absolute dominance.

Where other killers might gloat, Ezekiel does not speak. His silence is more terrifying than words. His strength is not just physical, it is primal. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/d160d28f12dadc99170c032cdaa004701a80346d.jpgEzekiel Concept, 2023

A Mind in Decay
Beneath the surface of this unstoppable killer is a man unraveling. Ezekiel is not whole. His mind is deteriorating, gnawed away by a mysterious mental illness that clouds his memory and thoughts. Every act of violence is both a release and a cry for clarity. He is desperate to stay in control, not just of others but of himself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/3dcaed3e490f3adc8eb9a963d12958c0cff89de7.gif
To fight the madness, he relies on a potent, experimental drug supplied through a shadowy criminal network operating within the prison. This drug keeps his thoughts sharp and his instincts focused, but it comes at a price. The more he takes, the deeper the hole he digs for himself. Ezekiel is constantly fighting a war inside his head, even as he dominates everyone around him.

This inner conflict is what makes Ezekiel more than just a killer. He is a man torn between two nightmares, the one he creates and the one he lives in.

Manhunt and the Reversal of Power
In the rare moments when prisoners are given a chance to fight back, when the hunted become the hunters, Ezekiel becomes even more terrifying. He doesn’t hide. He doesn’t panic. He fights with his bare hands, relying on instinct and sheer force to crush the uprising.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/f8f2c0a7e3873494769ab4090cd1a61cea398e90.gif

While others might retreat or outthink their pursuers, Ezekiel only charges forward. Every encounter is personal. Every act of retaliation is answered with something worse. For him, fear is not a weakness, it’s a tool he wields without speaking a word.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/45c0c665899c4af3a43f96b5338ffd30a32af023.gif

The Face of Tormentor
Ezekiel is more than a playable character. He is the face of Tormentor. The tone of the game is built around his presence, brutality, silence, and struggle. Where Bloody Mary is theatrical and cruel, Ezekiel is efficient and inevitable. Where she talks, he kills. Where she toys, he breaks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/7a11b782a98e1d88c3870a2c9ddd0b26e96e67d3.gif

But make no mistake, Ezekiel is not a mindless beast. He is a man who remembers just enough of who he used to be to know that he has become something else entirely.
And deep down, buried beneath the madness, he knows there’s no going back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/0cbade83118f6f6aa46339d80686f992382499c8.gif

notes.title: Bloody Mary – A killer you never SAW coming
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dZDL2tBCKoE;full]https://youtu.be/dZDL2tBCKoE[/previewyoutube]
In Tormentor, brutality is an art, and no two artists paint their horrors the same way. Ezekiel "The Tormentor" and Bloody Mary may share a thirst for pain, but their methods, styles, and personalities set them worlds apart.

With the legendary Shawnee Smith bringing Bloody Mary to life, she is more than just another executioner, she is a spectacle, a sadistic performer who thrives in the chaos of carnage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/3256986bc1b92bad576fee0a752fbfc4fff8e339.gif

The Art of Torture – Strength vs. Precision
Every executioner has their preferred tools, and for Ezekiel, brute force reigns supreme. He revels in the raw, animalistic act of destruction, hammers, fists, teeth, and sheer overwhelming power. His kills are merciless, silent, and beastlike.

Mary, however, turns pain into a performance, accustomed to livestreams and a public view, she makes sure the crowd is entertained. Precise, elegant, and obsessed with the sight of blood. Her weapons of choice? Scalpels, sickles, and anything that slices deep. She wants her victims to bleed, suffer, and leave a trail behind them, knowing full well they have no escape.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/ed4f491548fef070bcc0f1285bd4158cc0f870c5.gif

Manhunt – When the Prey Strikes Back
When the tables turn and prisoners are given a chance to fight back, Tormentor and Mary handle the hunt differently.

Ezekiel fights like a beast, using only his hands, teeth, and a knife for executions. He doesn’t need anything else, his sheer strength is his deadliest weapon.

Mary is fast, agile, and relentless. Wielding razor-sharp sickles, she can cut down prisoners in an instant. Any victim who tries to run will leave a bloody trail, leading her straight to their hiding place.
Ezekiel breaks you, but Mary plays with you, a cat toying with its prey before the final kill.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/f8faa9d77bd928a790e904d7fc121b414c7fe226.gif

Shawnee Smith is Mary

Shawnee Smith, known for her unforgettable role as Amanda Young in SAW, stepping into this blood-soaked role, Mary becomes more than just a character, she’s an experience. Her delivery, mannerisms, and sadism will turn Mary into a nightmare you’ll never forget.

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/1048afc2901e508a32f77c174f191a7ec2f32097.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/34da8ff8b40b04b6081f30c81f5c7459665ec3b7.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/a78e4f6cf3c7bd383c14cbaa668f53efab498780.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398440/1c2440ef336366935504c01d6e087ba804b3fe24.jpg 
Bloody Mary Concept Art - Higher Res of these images can be found on our Discord.[hr][/hr]The Nightmare Begins
With both Ezekiel and Mary in play, Tormentor delivers two distinct styles of horror, one built on raw strength and brutality, the other on precision, speed, and the art of suffering.

notes.title: MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We would like to invite you to the video presentation organized together with Rely On Horror - "MADNIGHT 2021: Horror Showcase", during which new materials from the widely understood horror games produced by Madmind Studio will be presented, with guest participation of developers from other studios.

MADNIGHT 2021: The Horror Showcase takes place December 16, 2021.

The entire event will be available at www.relyonhorror.com - one of the largest, most popular websites focused on horror games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139853/d92e8046f12eb649c01404242936cde9a3529667.jpg

MADNIGHT 2021 is an event unprecedented in the gaming industry, during which players will be able to get to meet the Hell Messenger for the first time - a mysterious creature with which they have been interacting for many months on our social media and Madmind Studio's Discord channel.

The Hell Messenger will take viewers into a terrifying world of horror that can take many forms. Have you ever wondered what working in a crematorium looks like? What does a person with advanced paranoid schizophrenia feel and see? Or maybe you want an extreme dose of uncompromising brutality and gore? You will see all these and many other attractions soon during MADNIGHT 2021!

MADNIGHT 2021 Horror Showcase will feature:

- Madmind Studio
- Black Rat
- Live Motion Games
- Lunarium Creations
- IGNIBIT
- Woodland Games

Over the past five years, Madmind Studio has become synonymous with frightening, controversial and violent games. This year's premiere of the studio's latest game, Succubus, was very well received by players and critics who decided to give the game very positive recommendations.

In addition to good grades, Succubus achieved great financial results. Released on October 5 2021, the game has so far made more money on Steam than the studio's previous game, Agony, in more than three years since its release.

“Succubus, announced back in 2018, after almost three full years of production, has finally been released. We wanted the game to be able to defend itself with the quality of workmanship and an original, previously unheard of in video games, dose of uncensored brutality on the day of its premiere. We are looking forward to the premiere of the first Succubus DLC, which will be released during MADNIGHT 2021 ” - Madmind Studio.

See you soon!
